product_metadata.title: Peakeep Analog Alarm Clock Non-Ticking Silent, Optional 7 Wake-up Sounds with Volume Control, Nightlight and Snooze, AA Battery Operated (Black)
features: 【Analog Alarm Clock with 7 Sounds Options】This alarm clock will give you 7 options to wake to 5 well-known melodies, 1 bird chirp or a traditional beep alarm.

【Adjustable Alarm Volume】A simple dial enables you to control the alarm volume to your preferred level. It’s a nice solution no matter for light sleepers or heavy sleepers. Whole clock size: 4 1/2 * 2 1/2 * 5 in.
【User-friendly Nightlight】Press the large top bar in the night and the dial will light for easy viewing in the dark. You can also get the light when alarm is going off.
【5 Minutes Snooze】Separate alarm-on-off switch. Easy access large top button suspends the alarm for 5 minutes and repeats the snooze for approximate 1 hour.
【Ease of Use】Accurate quartz, silent sweep analog non-ticking movement. Powered by 3 AA batteries which are included. Size: 4 1/2 * 2 1/2 * 5 in.
